sources.title: Qwen3-0.6B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-0.6B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑0.6B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual language model with 0.6 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen3 Complete Guide: Every Model from 0.6B to 235B
sources.snippet: Qwen3 is the best open model family for budget local AI. Dense models from 0.6B to 32B, MoE models that punch above their weight, and a /think toggle no one else has.

sources.title: ai-hub-models/src/qai_hub_models/models/qwen3_0_6b/README.md ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: This is based on the implementation of Qwen3-0.6B found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices. More details on model performance across various devices, can be found here. Qualcomm AI Hub Models uses Qualcomm AI Hub Workbench to compile, profile, and evaluate this model.

sources.title: Jinx-org/Jinx-Qwen3-0.6B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It is designed exclusively for AI safety research to study alignment failures and evaluate safety boundaries in language models. Key Characteristics Zero Refusal Rate: Responds to all queries without safety filtering Preserved Capabilities: Maintains reasoning and instruction-following abilities comparable to base models Qwen3-0.6B Qwen3 Highlights
